# cogNNitive

> Turn complex knowledge into simple, actionable Markdown models.

## Overview
- [cogNNitive](https://cognnitive.com/next/index.html): cogNNitive turns complex knowledge into plain Markdown models that people and AI agents can both read.

## Tutorials
- [Create your first domaiNN](https://cognnitive.com/next/first-domain.html): Install the skills and the MCP server, then create a domaiNN and your first kNNowledge document.

## Guides
- [Validate your domaiNN](https://cognnitive.com/next/validate-domain.html): Check one kNNowledge document or a whole domaiNN, and fix the common findings.

## Concepts
- [The levels of cogNNitive](https://cognnitive.com/next/levels.html): The four levels, from the meta-specification language to your own kNNowledge.

## Reference
- [Domain layout and tools](https://cognnitive.com/next/reference.html): The main folders of a domaiNN and the MCP tools you will use first.

## Legal
- [Legal notice](https://cognnitive.com/next/legal.html): Licence and where to find the legal notice and the privacy policy.
